items.title: Optimizing cost per task and proving agent ROI on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Comparing per-token prices hides the real cost of running a model on Amazon Bedrock. This post shows how to calculate the true cost per task across four hidden cost drivers, reduce it with caching, routing, and output constraints, and prove agent ROI with human baselines, holdout experiments, and a five-dimension scorecard.
items.creator: Majd Arbash

items.title: Building a self-service LLM gateway with Amazon Bedrock and LiteLLM
items.summary: Build a self-service LLM gateway with LiteLLM on AWS Fargate that puts Amazon Bedrock foundation models behind an OpenAI-compatible API. Developers get instant access through a single API key, while platform teams gain per-user cost controls, quota isolation, and observability.
items.creator: Sitaraman Vijay Krishna
